msg: Ignore the gnome colours, I don't think they mean anything. Pick one side and stick to it, even when the rewards are medium. This seems to be best overall, as the rewards appear to build up to the better ones when you keep choosing one side on repeat. If the rewards become consistently low (for 2-3 trials in a row) then swap to the other side and stick to that one for a while. Don't swap back and forth as this seems to create low rewards on both sides. This might all just be superstition and there might be no pattern at all. Who knows? Good luck!
